title: Chat lists stall and pushes are lost when the database pool fills.
whatHappens: 323 pool waits, 171 connect timeouts and 20 failed pushes between 18Z and 22:41Z on 17 Nov. Small bursts at 05Z, 07Z and 10Z on 18 Nov, none after 10:33Z. The presence query is still slow on live (66 slow runs since 11Z, max 6.4 s). Came back after PR 4483 and PR 4498.
fix: a separate presence pool with a time limit (proposed).
